description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for WebAudioPlayer and its factory within the Rialto client media component. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to WebAudioPlayer functionality.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating WebAudioPlayer instances, implementing IWebAudioPlayerFactory.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Main class implementing IWebAudioPlayer, IWebAudioPlayerIpcClient, and IControlClient, managing Web Audio playback and IPC communication.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerFactory
methods.description: Default constructor for the factory class.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IWebAudioPlayer instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Constructor initializing WebAudioPlayer with client, mime type, priority, config, IPC factory, and client controller.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the Web Audio stream.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data buffer for playback.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device buffer info and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the WebAudioPlayer client.
